meta.name: story-cover
meta.description: 小说封面生成。根据书名、作者名自动分析题材风格，调用 GPT-Image-2 生成含标题和署名的专业级网文封面；Codex CLI 优先使用内置 ImageGen，无需单独 API Key。触发方式：/story-cover、/封面、「帮我做个封面」「生成封面图」「做个小说封面」「封面设计」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入书名与作者名,自动生成带标题和署名的网文封面图
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在写网文、需要封面但不会用设计软件
copy.tagline_en: Turn a book title and author name into a ready-to-publish web-novel cover image
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write web novels and need a cover without design tools

howto.what: Claude 会变成小说封面设计师:读取书名和笔名判定题材,拼好英文提示词后调用 GPT-Image-2(Codex 会话有内置 ImageGen 时优先用它)生成含书名和作者名的封面图,存到输出目录,并附一份提示词副本。
howto.when: 当你提到“/story-cover”、“/封面”等指令,或要求做小说封面时接管;若缺书名或笔名,它会先问你再动手。

say.text: 帮我做个封面,书名《青云记》,笔名青衫
say.note: 它会先问你封面存哪、投哪个平台

say.text: 书名《青云记》笔名青衫,投番茄小说,要人物特写
say.note: 按平台比例出图,并导出上传尺寸版

say.text: 这版书名换成毛笔字,色调再暗一点
say.note: 基于上一版重新生成一版

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a novel-cover designer: it reads the title and pen name, picks a genre, then calls GPT-Image-2 (built-in ImageGen first in Codex) to render a cover carrying the title and author name, saved into your output folder with a prompt copy.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you use /story-cover or /封面, or ask for a novel cover; if the title or pen name is missing, it asks first.

say_en.text: Make a cover for my novel 'The Azure Cloud', pen name Qingshan
say_en.note: It first asks where to save it and for which platform

say_en.text: Title 'Azure Cloud', pen name Qingshan, for Fanqie, close-up portrait
say_en.note: Sizes for the platform and exports an upload copy

say_en.text: Change the title font to brush calligraphy and darken the colors
say_en.note: Regenerates a new version from the last one
